svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four slide blocks, 60 x 60 x 20 mm (20 mm thick = the side plate),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bored 40 mm in the middle for a flanged bronze bush.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit in the 60 mm slots with 0.2 mm clearance; break the edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six flanged bronze bushes 30 x 40 x 20 mm, 52 mm flange 6 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: thick, pressed in from the outside; a grease hole in each.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 3 mm keeper plate on the inside face holds each block in.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pinch screws M16 x 120 (two), bending screws M20 x 150 (two),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each with a collar captured in the top of its block so it can

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: push and pull; handwheels 90 mm (pinch) and 110 mm (bending)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the screws run in the threaded holes of the top bridges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each block slides its full travel by turning its screw.
